decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship GIS platform and strategic product line, it has high option value, strong fit with the core integration business, and the continuity expected by German enterprise and public-sector customers makes withdrawal unlikely.

Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established geospatial offer and still showed dedicated market presence after launch, so the option is worth keeping, though a broad portfolio and maintenance effort create some pruning risk if demand stays only moderate.

The search extension received a visible version update after launch and builds on the firm's existing web-map capabilities, so its carrying cost is relatively low and the product remains a worthwhile option unless market feedback turns clearly negative.
